verification_report.summary: The proof is correct under the three accepted internal inputs. The capacity estimate is applied only after its threshold exceeds 1; damped continuity applies because the smooth potentials are nonpositive omega-psh and converge in capacity; the positive lower-form bound gives the required measure domination; and the displayed comparison proves convergence in the whole total variation norm. Fixed total mass then yields the tail-mass limit. A single weakly convergent subsequence works for every real T>0 because the shallow restriction converges in total variation along the full sequence for each T, so no T-dependent extraction or diagonal argument is needed. No external-paper citation occurs.
